program.section_heading: New Product Development and Fabrication Option (CERT)
outcomes: Students develop machine tool technology based fabrication plans.
Students evaluate the feasibility of the rapid prototyping various products.
Students produce a cost-effective plan for an automation product.
Students produce a portfolio of new design technology for the production of new products.
Students select a plan for manufacturing and procurement.
Students take a product through the stages of new product development.
